summary: Both blocking findings are valid and require small spec changes: define the cache scope contract and include resolved invocation identity in the cache key.

items.title: Spec-local cache scope has no implementation target
items.rationale: The current Agent has FlowManager context for active flows but no existing non-active spec-local scope input. The spec must define a deterministic scope contract.
items.evidence: src/lib/agent.js constructor accepts optional flowManager; spec review states ordinary non-active calls do not identify a current spec-local scope.

items.title: Cache key ignores mutable resolved profile behavior
items.rationale: The resolved provider profile command and flags affect invocation semantics, so the cache identity must include those fields or equivalent invalidation data.
items.evidence: src/lib/agent.js resolve() returns provider/profile/providerKey/profileKey, and _buildInvocation uses profile.command, args, jsonOutputFlag, jsonSchemaFlag, and jsonSchemaMode.
